name: rollo
description: A rubber-ball platformer. Roll and bounce Rollo through ten hand-built levels across a meadow, a flooded grotto and a dusk fort: light every spark to open the gate, dodge spikes and patrolling urchins, ride springs, and puff up with pumps to float on water before a pin lets you squeeze through narrow gaps. Beacons save your spot; best times and fewest falls are saved.
